hero.title: Donate
hero.subtitle: Choose one clear way to help. Your gift supports sports, nutrition, family programmes, and everyday care for Love 21 members.

t100.impact: Provides sports equipment for one member for a month

t250.impact: Funds one vocational training workshop session

t500.impact: Supports a member's participation in community activities for 3 months

t1000.impact: Helps run a full day of inclusive sports programs

body.title: Ability deserves opportunity
body.p1: Love 21 members bring talent, ambition, and determination. Your gift helps remove the barriers that prevent those strengths from being fully seen in sport, work, family life, and the wider community.
body.p2: For donations of HKD$100 or above, an official receipt will be issued and mailed to you upon request. Please contact Maggie at Maggie@love21foundation.com for enquiries.

aside.title: One gift or lasting support
aside.body: Choose one-time, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual, or annual giving securely through MoonClerk.

other.title: Donate by other means
other.paymeBody: Open PayMe and scan Love 21's official QR code to make a donation.
other.paymeNote: PayMe donations are reflected in campaign progress after Love 21 staff reconcile them.
other.chequeNote: Cheques can be written out to "Love 21 Foundation Limited" and mailed to:

shop.title: Wishlist
shop.subtitle: Give practical tools that help Love 21 members train, learn, create, and show what they can do.
shop.heading: Help remove a barrier
shop.body: Purchase a requested item directly when a supplier link is available, or contribute any amount toward the goal. Love 21 updates each total as items and contributions are secured.

opportunities.emptySoon: New opportunities will be shared here soon.
opportunities.remarkMoonclerk: Please write "{{title}}" in the MoonClerk Remarks field so Love 21 can designate your gift.
opportunities.mockSupportNote: Use the mock donation form to support this priority in the demo.

mockForm.title: Complete your mock donation
mockForm.description: No real payment is taken in this demo. A successful mock payment is recorded so the dashboard and progress bars update.
mockForm.frequencyMonthlyDesc: A recurring status appears on your dashboard.
mockForm.wishlistSelectedHint: You are contributing toward a wishlist item. Choose an amount below.
mockForm.campaignSelectedHint: This gift supports a time-bound campaign.
mockForm.causeSelectedHint: This gift supports ongoing Love 21 programmes.
mockForm.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. This donation will appear on your supporter dashboard.
mockForm.prioritiesWishlistNote: Wishlist items appear in the form above under “Wishlist items”. Contribute from the wishlist page or pick one in the dropdown.

wishlist.emptySoon: Love 21's current needs will be shared here soon.
wishlist.remarkMoonclerk: Add "{{title}}" in the MoonClerk Remarks field to designate your contribution.
